    storage: preserve sandbox trees with restic
    
    The direct S3 mirror stores only regular file data and replaces each changed
    object. It loses directories, links, modes, and timestamps.
    
    Run restic in the unprivileged container. Restore before service startup,
    take periodic snapshots, and take a final snapshot after gRPC work stops.
    Use content-defined chunks so that each snapshot uploads only new data.
    
    Test metadata restoration and chunk reuse against a separate S3 node. State
    the limits for privileged metadata and inode change time.
